subject: On-demand throughput top-up and rate guard options
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@brightcart.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question: on-demand throughput top-up + guardrails

Hi Camila,

We're ramping to a public beta on Aug 3 and expect a concentrated burst lasting ~48-72 hours where token consumption will spike ~6-8x for specific endpoints. Our core asks: can we get an on-demand top-up path that lets us temporarily raise rate limits and quota for that window, avoids a permanent commit change, and keeps overrun invoicing predictable (preferably a capped blended rate rather than full list overage pricing)?

I've attached our Q3 traffic forecast (Q3_traffic_forecast.csv). Procurement also asked about any short-term discount for emergency bursts and what guarantees we can offer around rollback to our baseline after the window.

Can you outline options and any lead times for activating an on-demand top-up? We need a quick turnkey path — engineer availability is limited on our side.

Thanks,
Alice
Product Ops — BrightCart

Attachment: Q3_traffic_forecast.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@brightcart.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question: on-demand throughput top-up + guardrails

Hi Alice — thanks for the forecast + heads-up. We can do an on-demand top-up with three important pieces: a transient quota window, a per-token blended overrun rate for that window (tiered by blocks of volume), and an automated rollback that restores your baseline commit after the window ends.

High-level options:
- Fast top-up (self-serve): activation in ~30 mins, fixed uplift up to 4x baseline, no admin review. Overrun billed at standard PAYG rate.
- Managed top-up (recommended for your spike): activation within 4 hours, uplift to any required QPS with a blended overrun ladder and a short-term discount for the initial 72 hours. Includes an SLA for activation and a one-time on-call engineer available if needed.
- Reserve burst (pre-purchased cushion): pre-buy headroom credits at a discounted rate, automatically consumed before overrun pricing — best if you expect frequent spikes.

We can draft provisional terms and a DocuSign for a managed top-up with a blended billing ladder (example attached: provisional_topup_terms.pdf). Ben, can you advise on the discount band we can offer for a one-off 72-hour managed top-up for a mid-market customer? Marissa — any constraints on waiving the activation fee for pockets like this?

Next steps for BrightCart: if you confirm managed top-up, I'll route the provisional terms and a DocuSign and schedule the activation window (we'll need a PO or signed DocuSign before we flip the managed switch).

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: provisional_topup_terms.pdf (PDF, stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question: on-demand throughput top-up + guardrails

Camila / Marissa — ran numbers vs. BRG-2025-1123 MRR and usage profile. Suggested managed-topup pricing ladder (one-off 72h window):

- Tier A (0-500M tokens): PAYG * 0.9 (10% short-term discount)
- Tier B (500M-2B tokens): PAYG * 0.78 (22% discount)
- Tier C (>2B tokens): PAYG * 0.65 (35% discount)

Additionally: a one-time activation fee of $1,500, waivable if BrightCart signs a 3-month soft-commit or prepays at least 50% of estimated top-up. SLA: activation within 4 hours for managed requests. Rollback: automatic to baseline 6 hours after window end unless BrightCart requests extension.

If we want to be more aggressive we could offer a capped blended rate instead of tier multipliers (e.g., $0.0009/token flat for the 72h window) — that helps procurement with predictability but increases Redwood revenue risk.

I recommend offering waiver of the activation fee for this case if BrightCart accepts the blended cap option and signs the DocuSign today.

-Ben
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question: on-demand throughput top-up + guardrails

+1 to Ben's suggestion, but a couple of guardrails before we commit to the full blended cap:
1) Require a traffic-pattern spike verification (simple smoke test during activation) to avoid malicious traffic being captured under the discounted band. Engineering will run a lightweight verification script during the first hour of the window.
2) Add a clause limiting the number of managed top-ups we provide per customer per rolling quarter for the discounted option — otherwise we create a durable expectation.
3) APPROVE waiving the activation fee under these conditions (DocuSign signed + PO or prepay).

If Ben wants to offer the flat blended cap, ask legal to include an overrun reconciliation clause and a retro review if post-window telemetry indicates differing distributions (we may need to apply an adjustment or require partial settlement).

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@brightcart.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Managed 72h top-up — terms and next steps (BRG-2025-1123)

Hi Alice — looping back with a concrete path. We recommend the managed 72h top-up. Key bullets below and attached formal terms + excerpt of the portion of our TOS that covers temporary top-ups (redwood_tos_excerpt.txt).

- Activation: managed, within 4 hours of a signed DocuSign + PO.
- Capacity uplift: up to requested QPS for the 72-hour window.
- Billing: blended-ladder approach per Ben's proposal (Tiered multipliers), or a flat blended cap if you prefer predictability.
- Activation fee: $1,500 waived if DocuSign is executed and PO provided before activation.
- Rollback: automatic to baseline 6 hours after window close; extensions require request before the window ends.
- Verification: brief smoke test on first hour by our infra team; we'll notify you before the activation completes.

If this looks good, I'll:
1) send the provisional DocuSign (link: https://www.docusign.com/BRG-2025-1123/topup)
2) schedule activation with infra and include the on-call engineer
3) escalate to billing for a retro true-up path in case post-window telemetry materially differs from the forecast.

Would you like the blended cap option (predictable invoice) or the tiered multiplier (likely lower expected cost for you but higher variance)? If you confirm by EOD, we can lock the waived activation fee.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: provisional_topup_terms.pdf, redwood_tos_excerpt.txt
